metadata.title: A periodic minimal hypersurface in Euclidean 4-space with Clifford cone singularities
metadata.abstract: Let $\sigma(t)=\operatorname{sl}(\varpi t)$ be the lemniscatic sine, normalized to have period $2$. We study the zero set $\mathscr{M}$ of $S(x)=\sigma(x_1)\sigma(x_3)-\sigma(x_2)\sigma(x_4)$ in $\mathbb{R}^{4}$. We show that $\mathscr{M}$ is a complete embedded minimal hypersurface with infinitely many isolated singularities, which are exactly the vertices of the regular honeycomb of $\mathbb{R}^{4}$ by $24$-cells. Near every singular point $\mathscr{M}$ is an analytic image of the Clifford cone, and $\mathscr{M}$ is a stationary integral varifold with density $\pi/2$ at each singularity. The isometry group of $\mathscr{M}$ is generated by the translations of the root lattice $D_4$ and a hyperoctahedral group of order $384$ fixing the centre of a $24$-cell; it has index three in the symmetry group of the honeycomb, acts transitively on the singular points, and contains a symmetry which is not visible from the defining equation. Seen from the centre of a $24$-cell, $\mathscr{M}$ is the zero set of a theta series of a translate of the Hurwitz quaternions, which makes the whole symmetry group manifest; the sections of $\mathscr{M}$ by a family of parallel hyperplanes are triply periodic surfaces with cubic symmetry which change topology through conical points. Finally, $\mathscr{M}$ is obtained from a union of $2$-planes by attaching cones over $2$-tori, and its quotient by the lattice of periods is a compact minimal hypersurface in a flat $4$-torus with exactly three singular points and infinite Morse index; we show that its regular part is one-sided and compute its Euler characteristic and integral homology.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 具有 Clifford 锥奇点的周期极小超曲面
analysis.workSummary: 在 R⁴ 中研究双纽线正弦定义的零集 σ(x₁)σ(x₃)−σ(x₂)σ(x₄)=0。证明其为完备嵌入的极小超曲面，带无限多个孤立奇点，恰位于正则 24 胞蜂巢顶点；每个奇点附近是 Clifford 锥的解析像，并作为驻定整 varifold 具有密度 π/2。
techniques: 双纽线正弦的解析零集
D₄ 根格与 Hurwitz 四元数 theta 级数
周期商的拓扑及指标分析
analysis.breakthrough: 给出对称性与拓扑可显式追踪的周期奇异极小几何模型：周期商是平坦四环面内有三个奇点且 Morse 指标无穷的紧极小超曲面，其正则部分单侧。
analysis.limitations: 完备嵌入在这里允许已明确的孤立锥奇点，不能称处处光滑或稳定极小超曲面；完整等距群是蜂巢对称群的指数三子群，不是整个蜂巢群。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。实际 PDF SHA-256 核对一致，39 页完整提取、无短文本页。标准检索无命中；补充点写 A. I. 唯一命中为第 38 页参考文献作者 A. I. Markushevich 的姓名缩写，不是 AI 使用声明；未观察到作者自身披露。

analysis.priorityReason: 极小超曲面、锥奇点及不稳定性的显式几何结合，和几何分析主线十分相关。
